title: Istio mesh-mode policy is not projected into open ingress routes
claims: workload-scoped AuthorizationPolicy/PeerAuthentication and a mesh-only VirtualService produce no reachable ingress route
the report flags the mesh-mode resources as not translated, deferred or mesh-only
not_claimed: DENY semantics of the AuthorizationPolicy (needs a mesh data plane with identity)
not_established: Istio full mesh: sidecar or ambient capture, SPIFFE identity, STRICT mTLS and mesh_authz enforcement with a real request. If the converter emits a mesh slice, only `validate -m mesh` is attempted (with --mesh-validate-env).
source_semantics: In Istio these resources apply to sidecar/ambient workload traffic and define no ingress route; a VirtualService without gateways binds to the mesh. Ferrum's Istio controller consumes CRDs in mesh mode and stock_xds is discovery-only with local policy (docs/mesh.md), so a file-mode ingress projection must not expose them.
